name: Nuode New Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nuode New Materials Co.,Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells electrolytic copper foils for lithium batteries in China and internationally. The company offers micrometre ultrathin copper foil, high tensile strength and high elongation copper foil, porous copper foil, ultra-thick electrolytic copper foil, and HVLP ultra low-profile copper foil, as well as composite current collectors, including composite copper foil and composite aluminum foil. It is also involved in the production and sales of photovoltaic energy storage, wires and cables and accessories, and materials trading; and photovoltaic power generation and contract energy management service.
